verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a cloud creative platform and API like Runway, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics opt-out, data-collection controls, or privacy settings. The cost and usage visibility features are billing reporting, not a tracking opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
